t: Buy an old farmhouse? - Bogleheads.org
s: I would skip it, an old farmhouse will be an uncomfortable, expensive money pit. My in-laws have a 100 year old house and it seems like such a constant pain to maintain. Nothing is level, something is always broken, the insulation is terrible. Now... that said... I would sing a different tune if you could first buy yourself 10-15 acres and then build a brand new, simple and efficient 4 bedroom, 2-3 bath with a basement (preferably walkout) and bury part of the house with dirt.
